content.comment_body: I'm experiencing the same problem using [article_no] ES10 with [product_name] [version_no]. When I try to set up master/slave communication, I receive the message ''The Connected Base Module does not support network communication.'' Is this correct? If I can't connect via USB, how am I supposed to transfer a program to the module? I'm new to this and would appreciate help—please mention anything obvious I might have missed. Thanks.
Networking through Ethernet is supported only on modules from [article_no] or newer. With a [article_no], establishing a master/slave connection is not possible.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter confusion when attempting to set up master/slave networking with [article_no] ES10 using [product_name] [version_no]. The error message about unsupported network communication frustrates inexperienced users who are unaware of module limitations. This reveals a gap between user expectations and hardware capabilities, suggesting the need for clearer information regarding network features.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to set up master/slave communication and transfer programs using a USB cable, regardless of the module version. They are also seeking straightforward setup instructions, especially because of their limited experience.
